Top matches by score v2 Candidates matching your criteria — not a recommendation. Only names whose 0.70–0.80Δ Apr–Jul 2027 call passes the tradability/data gate are ranked, by daily percentile ranks across today's gated names. Tap a card for the breakdown.

Trendline breaks (context only)
  • Timeframes: monthly, weekly, daily. Each column shows one compact chip: the highest-scoring latest break across the short (“s”) and broad (“b”) lines. Lines join the two latest causally confirmed swing highs (descending resistance, ↑) or lows (rising support, ↓).
  • Chip labels: Break (close just confirmed), Hold (still beyond the line), Retest (retested and closed beyond), Failed (failed to hold), or “—” if there is no close-confirmed break. n/a = data unavailable or history too short. The number is the 0–100 quality score. Color follows direction (green ↑ / red ↓) and strength (strong ≥75, moderate 50–74, weak <50). A left edge mark highlights a fresh Break. ≠ means the other horizon differs in direction or state — hover for that line, click the chip for full short/broad detail.
  • A break needs a completed-bar close beyond the line by 0.25×ATR14. Partial periods are excluded.
  • Quality score: touches (max 40) + time held, per-timeframe tiers (max 35) + break volume (max 25); failed to hold = 0. “Active break on” filters to Break or Retest on the selected timeframe(s).
  • Not part of the score, gate or sort. A break is not proof a trend has reversed.
How the score works (v2, 0–100)
  • 1. Contract: across the Apr–Jul 2027 expiries, the call nearest 0.75Δ inside 0.70–0.80Δ (IV and delta solved from the bid/ask mid, Black-Scholes, 4% rate, no dividend); if several expiries qualify, the one with the tightest spread. The old highest-OI “sample” call is still shown as legacy context.
  • 2. Gate (pass/fail, not points): two-sided quote, spread ≤10% of mid, open interest ≥100, ≥260 daily bars, ≥120 days of IV history. Failing names show “Gated out” with the reason and no score.
  • 3. Score: each input becomes a percentile rank (0–1) among today’s gated names, then weighted: vol cheapness 25 = ln(1-year realized vol ÷ the contract’s IV); 12-month momentum skipping the last month 25; closeness to the 52-week high 15; cost 15 = spread % of mid, lower ranks higher; low idiosyncratic vol 10 = residual volatility vs SPY over 63 days, lower ranks higher; profitability 10 = Yahoo profit margin. An input missing for a row is dropped and its weight renormalised (listed on the card).
  • Display only: support, IV rank, pullback, analyst consensus/targets and trendlines are context — not in the score, gate or sort.
Prices are prior completed sessions only. The score measures fit to these criteria, not future returns.
